note.question: What determines a distribution system in which retailers replenish perishable goods from a warehouse, which, in turn, replenishes from an outside source?
note.overview: The model considers a distribution system in which retailers replenish perishable goods from a warehouse, which, in turn, replenishes from an outside source. Demand at each retailer depends on exogenous features and a random shock, and unfulfilled demand is lost. The objective is to obtain a data-driven replenishment and allocation policy that minimizes the average inventory cost per time period.
